info.description:
Hermetical local development environment.

Setup steps:
1. Start server: docker-compose up --build
2. Run seeder: docker exec -it guidewire_project-server-1 python scripts/seed_historical_data.py
3. Fetch zone IDs: GET {{base_url}}/api/admin/zones (or check DB) and paste into the zone_id variables above.
4. Select this environment in Postman, then run the Phase 2 collection via Collection Runner.

All worker_id, policy_id, claim_id, disruption_event_id values are set automatically by test scripts when you run requests in order.
